conclusions: The original NP and Ew use exactly the two square roots of nPt divided by the original word normC. For every head of size j<=r its old-head factor is positive and independent of the terminal Gram parameter.

Appending a singleton contributes |c|^(2(2(r-j)+k-1)) below the terminal level and (|c|^2-TTprime)^(k-1) at the terminal level. Outside the positive terminal domain the original RR is zero, so no invalid square-root simplification of a negative formal power is used.

Actual partial-head and terminal transfer identify the normalized one-coordinate integral with (a_h/S_w) beta(U_s x,x) using the original Haar measures. The Schwartz marginal below the terminal level and compact positive support at the terminal level give the required continuous integrable representative at every nonzero c.

Positivity below the terminal level uses the actual Jacquet form. Terminal type weights are positive; StatementD259-270 makes every invalid head and every index greater than r+1 zero. This covers the full PosAt universal index quantifier.

TBB.AdmW places no block-position restriction on an old word. Each old letter occupies at most one underlying grid block; at least K long blocks, or K short nodes for degree zero, remain free because |w|+K<=N. Every selected plus and shifted-minus extension meets the exact original IsExt and cut separation.

The rational old-word factors are exactly (y-a+1)/(y-a) for plus and (a-y)/(a-y-1) for minus. The shifted separation D>=N^2/8 and N>=20 give the uniform logarithmic bound 20/49, hence the exact factor exp(10/49) after inverse square root.

The established actual Capelli leading coefficient is s^K, with degree 2j per insertion, plus at y and minus at y+1. Tail-first word order and the mixed contraction sign agree with the source. The actual wave isometry and mixed Cauchy inequality apply to every compact coefficient in the finite interpolation.

The exact extended word normalizers cancel a_h and S_w, leaving the stated Lambda_j and the probability-weighted geometric mean of the two original extended energies. No grid cardinality loss is added.

The finite maximum contains the old word and every constructed plus and minus extension. The same maximum gives both the unweighted and weighted bounds, so their minimum has one admissible witness wprime. K=0 and s=0 give the literal source conventions.

The arithmetic spectral specialization retains g^(-m), kappa^(m-1), t_v, k, N^3/Delta and every interpolation power. The original phase substitution has s=2*pi*i*ell/(g*lambda); its Jacobian is not absorbed into the frequency scale.
